newsitem.title: USA: Wash. nearly halves output at 1,158 MW power plant.
newsitem.headline: Wash. nearly halves output at 1,158 MW power plant.

text.p: Electricity output at the 1,158 megawatt (MW) Washington Nuclear Power 2 plant (WNP-2) was further reduced amid repairs, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.

The Richland, Wash., plant is generating at 54 percent of capacity, down from 93 percent the past several days, after work began on its recirculation pump adjustable speed drives, NRC said in its daily status report.
NRC did not indicate when WNP-2 would resume full output.

WNP-2 is owned by a consortium of public utilities in Washington state and operated by Washington Public Power Supply System. Bonneville Power Administration, a federal agency, markets the plant's electricity output.
